page.overview:
What is Rokol?

Rokol is a region or city that presumably was part of the empire of Sarnath. On the thousand year anniversary of Sarnath's conquest of the city of Ib, among the many who attended the celebration were princes of Rokol. (: "The Doom That Came to Sarnath")
